concurrency.limitation: Cooperative lock records a reservation; it cannot detect uncoordinated external work.

configuration.baselineRole: Untimed complete-wire/decode/allocation oracle only; not one of the two measured arms.
configuration.order: Seeded shuffled case order each round; alternating arm order by round+case index; same independent fixtures per pair.

scope.timedWork: Actual current encodeSnapshot for each recipient, or actual current prepareSnapshotCars once per broadcast followed by actual encodePreparedSnapshot for each recipient. All encoder allocations, scalar conversion, compact/full construction and owned packet copies are inside; output reference ring writes are inside.
scope.setupWork: Imports, manifests, fixtures/header objects, reference ring allocation, retained reference packets, all decoding/byte/hash/ownership checks and report I/O outside timing.
scope.allocationScope: Separate untimed instrumentation observes actual ByteWriter buffers/finish outputs and compact buffers. Production allocations stay inside timing, while no instrumentation runs there.
scope.limitations: Local Node encoder comparison. No world capture, server queue/latch/event execution, transport, browser/physical-network latency, FPS, heap or GC result. Bounded ring retains final outputs for 32 fixtures, not every historical packet. Intermediate field sizes between the minimum and 12 cars are not all measured; a recipient threshold is a scoped engineering choice, not a universal crossover.

preflight.purpose: Untimed actual-baseline equality, ownership and allocation observation
preflight.method: Actual writer methods and backing buffer identities; same W07 observations extended to intermediate recipient counts and minimal fields. All prototype instrumentation is restored before workloads.
preflight.allocationLimits: Cumulative capacities of observed backing buffers, not peak memory, all JS heap, allocator overhead or GC cost. Prepared FULL is already a finish buffer and is counted only once. Header/fixture objects are outside measurement. Every production encoder allocation and once-per-broadcast preparation stays inside timing.

timing.note: Untimed smoke; all workload elapsed durations and medians are null.
